_source: Dragon Hatchling paper (Pathway, 2025). Reported: ~5% sparsity, non-negative activations, monosemantic synapses.

sparsity.description: Roughly 5% of neurons are active at any moment. Activity varies with input predictability — not a fixed budget.
sparsity.note: Precomputed. Values are illustrative of reported BDH behavior.

neuron_grid.description: A 20×20 grid representing 400 neurons. ~20 are active (5%). Click to see what concept each active neuron encodes.

synaptic_memory.description: In BDH, attention is reformulated as synaptic memory. The weight matrix W_syn is updated during inference via a Hebbian-style write: ΔW = η · v · kᵀ, where k is the key (query pattern) and v is the value to associate. Reading is: output = W_syn · q (query).
synaptic_memory.contrast_with_transformer: In a Transformer, the KV cache grows linearly with sequence length. In BDH, the synaptic weight matrix W_syn has fixed size — it compresses the entire context into one matrix through superposition.
